```yaml
name: Release

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]

permissions:
  contents: write
  packages: write

jobs:
  release:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '18'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Build all targets
        run: npm run build:all

      - name: Validate build outputs
        run: |
          for file in dist/auto-image.{standalone,userscript,bookmarklet}.js dist/auto-image.bookmarklet.txt; do
            if [ ! -s "$file" ]; then
              echo "❌ Missing or empty: $file"
              exit 1
            fi
          done
          echo "✅ All outputs validated"

      - name: Generate timestamp-based version tag
        id: version
        run: |
          TIMESTAMP=$(date +"%Y.%m.%d-%H%M%S")
          TAG="v${TIMESTAMP}"
          echo "tag=${TAG}" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "Generated tag: ${TAG}"

      - name: Create Release
        id: create_release
        uses: actions/create-release@v1
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        with:
          tag_name: ${{ steps.version.outputs.tag }}
          release_name: Release ${{ steps.version.outputs.tag }}
          draft: false
          prerelease: false

      - name: Upload standalone build
        uses: actions/upload-release-asset@v1
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        with:
          upload_url: ${{ steps.create_release.outputs.upload_url }}
          asset_path: ./dist/auto-image.standalone.js
          asset_name: auto-image.standalone.js
          asset_content_type: application/javascript

      - name: Upload userscript build
        uses: actions/upload-release-asset@v1
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        with:
          upload_url: ${{ steps.create_release.outputs.upload_url }}
          asset_path: ./dist/auto-image.userscript.js
          asset_name: auto-image.userscript.js
          asset_content_type: application/javascript

      - name: Upload bookmarklet build
        uses: actions/upload-release-asset@v1
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        with:
          upload_url: ${{ steps.create_release.outputs.upload_url }}
          asset_path: ./dist/auto-image.bookmarklet.js
          asset_name: auto-image.bookmarklet.js
          asset_content_type: application/javascript

      - name: Upload bookmarklet text file
        uses: actions/upload-release-asset@v1
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        with:
          upload_url: ${{ steps.create_release.outputs.upload_url }}
          asset_path: ./dist/auto-image.bookmarklet.txt
          asset_name: auto-image.bookmarklet.txt
          asset_content_type: text/plain

      - name: Update latest release with stable download URLs
        run: |
          echo "Release created successfully!"
          echo "Stable download URLs:"
          echo "  Standalone: https://github.com/${{ github.repository }}/releases/latest/download/auto-image.standalone.js"
          echo "  Userscript: https://github.com/${{ github.repository }}/releases/latest/download/auto-image.userscript.js"
          echo "  Bookmarklet: https://github.com/${{ github.repository }}/releases/latest/download/auto-image.bookmarklet.js"
          echo "  Bookmarklet Text: https://github.com/${{ github.repository }}/releases/latest/download/auto-image.bookmarklet.txt"
```
